claims.claim_text: Salomon employs patented proprietary footwear technologies (Sensifit, Contagrip, Quicklace) and Amer Sports brands rely on extensive product/technology IP across footwear, apparel and equipment.
claims.subject: Salomon
claims.object_value: Sensifit / Contagrip / Quicklace footwear technology and related product IP
claims.source_quote: Salomon s patented Sensifit footwear technology providing precise and comfortable fit in combination with the differentiated Quicklace system ... Contagrip uses a proprietary traction technology ... The patented closure system for fast and easy fit adjustment on the fly.

claims.claim_text: Wilson has driven product innovation across football, baseball, tennis and golf for over a century, with patented basketball/ball technologies.
claims.subject: Wilson
claims.object_value: ball and racquet sports product technology (basketball, tennis, football)
claims.source_quote: Wilson has driven innovation across sports including football, baseball, tennis and golf for over a century ... Wilson s cushion core carcass in its basketballs ... Wilson s Triniti tennis balls.

claims.claim_text: Arc'teryx holds proprietary technical-apparel product IP (Alpha SV jacket construction, climbing harness designs, trail footwear).
claims.subject: Arc'teryx
claims.object_value: technical apparel / outdoor equipment product IP
claims.source_quote: The Alpha SV disrupted the industry and continues to drive innovation with game-changing design-elements ... The Vapor is an anatomically shaped, 360 thermo-moulded climbing harness.

claims.claim_text: ANTA Sports Products Limited is a significant-influence owner of Amer Sports and a related-party counterparty (purchases/sales of goods between the two).
claims.subject: ANTA Sports Products Limited
claims.predicate: is controlling/influence owner and related-party counterparty of
claims.source_quote: Owners, each with significant influence over Amer Sports, Inc.: ANTA Sports Products Limited, Anamered Investments Inc. FountainVest Partners ... Purchases of goods and services from ANTA Sports ... Sales to ANTA Sports.

claims.claim_text: Arc'teryx and Salomon co-develop new GORE-TEX membranes with Gore-Tex for jackets and footwear.
claims.subject: Amer Sports (Arc'teryx / Salomon)
claims.source_quote: Arc teryx and Salomon developing new, greener membranes with Gore-Tex for their jackets and shoes, improving the waterproofing and breathability.

claims.claim_text: Amer Sports operates a global physical footprint of over 330 owned retail stores (24 countries) and 19 distribution centers (operates 9) as of September 30, 2023.
claims.subject: Amer Sports
claims.object_value: 330+ owned retail stores; 19 distribution centers (9 operated)
claims.source_quote: As of September 30, 2023, we have over 330 owned retail stores and growing ... 19 distribution centers, of which we operate 9, globally as of September 30, 2023.

claims.claim_text: Arc'teryx loyalty program had over 1.7 million members in Greater China as of September 30, 2023 (grown from ~14,000 in 2018).
claims.subject: Arc'teryx
claims.predicate: has loyalty members in Greater China
claims.source_quote: Arc teryx s loyalty program includes over 1.7 million members in Greater China as of September 30, 2023, having grown from only fourteen thousand in 2018.

claims.claim_text: The Company restated its FY2022/2021/2020 financials to correct misstatements and is highly levered (EUR ~2.0bn institutional term loan + EUR ~4bn related-party shareholder loans), with recurring net losses and a going-concern-relevant reliance on a EUR315m RCF.
claims.subject: Amer Sports
claims.object_value: restatement of FY2020-2022 + ~$6bn total debt + recurring net losses
claims.source_quote: the 2022, 2021, and 2020 consolidated financial statements have been restated to correct certain misstatements ... a EUR 1.7 billion senior secured term loan facility ... Loans from related parties 4,039.0 ... Net loss -252.7 (2022).
